bias.label: Leaning down below 4,079 after hot CPI

event: US PPI, Fri 13 Nov 15:30 SAST (time UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: CPI came hot
bullets.text: October CPI rose 0.4% m/m against 0.3% expected, and core rose 0.3% against 0.2% expected; the yearly rate was not published because of missing 2025 data (Trading Economics).

bullets.title: Gold fell further
bullets.text: Gold was about 4,072 just before CPI at 15:24 SAST (Kitco) and Trading Economics later showed 4,049-4,057, so the exact price now is UNVERIFIED within a few dollars.

bullets.title: Big down day
bullets.text: Gold is down roughly 80-90 (about 2%) from today's high of 4,147.40 and is now testing Monday's low near 4,053 (Kitco, Trading Economics).

bullets.title: Hike odds high
bullets.text: Markets priced about 84% odds of a December Fed hike before CPI, and a hot print tends to keep those odds high (Trading Economics); the post-CPI figure is UNVERIFIED.

bullets.title: Dollar firmer
bullets.text: The dollar index is near 102.0, up about 0.3%, and the US 10-year yield is near 4.90% (Trading Economics, time UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Buyers underneath
bullets.text: Central banks bought 321 tonnes in Q3, which supports dips over the longer term but does not stop a fall today (FXEmpire).

levels.note: Pre-CPI low 4,067.80 and price 4,072 at 15:24 SAST (Kitco)

buy.title: Buy plan (counter-trend): dip that holds 4,030
look: This is counter-trend after a hot CPI, so use half size.
A dip into 4,030-4,035 that closes back up on the 15M.
The dollar index fading back below 101.6.
No entry in the first hour after CPI while candles are wild.
watch: Buying at 4,055 because it looks cheap after a big drop, with no zone and no stop.
A break of 4,030 can run to 4,000 quickly.
Fed speakers repeating hike talk can keep sellers in control.
Moving your stop lower when price gets close. That is how a small loss becomes a big one.

sell.title: Sell plan: rejection at 4,067-4,079
look: A bounce into 4,067-4,079 that fails, not a sell at 4,055 on support.
A clear 15M rejection wick or bearish close inside the zone.
The dollar index holding near 102.0 or higher.
Take some profit at 4,050 and move the stop to entry only after that.
watch: Chasing the drop by selling at 4,055 straight into 4,049-4,053 support.
Short-covering after a big CPI move can spike price through 4,090.
US-Iran or other headlines can bring safe-haven buying back fast.
Re-entering again and again after being stopped out. One attempt, then step away.
